newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Gencor Mozambique smelter announcement Tues.
newsitem.headline: Gencor Mozambique smelter announcement Tues.

text.p: South African mining house Gencor Ltd will announce its decision on the proposed $1.25 billion aluminium smelter in Mozambique on Tuesday, the group said on Monday.
"Mr Rob Barbour, chairman of Alusaf (a Gencor unit) will announce Gencor's decision regarding the proposed Mozambique Aluminium Smelter," the group said in an invitation.
The announcement is due at 1230 GMT.
Last week Gencor said it planned to spin off its non-precious metal assets into a UK-based firm Billiton Plc and use it to raise $1 billion from international equity markets.

Chairman Brian Gilbertson said the Mozambique project was one of several possible applications for funds raised. Alusaf Ltd said in April that construction of the smelter could begin in October for completion in August 2000.
Gilbertson said the smelter was likely to produce in excess of 233,000 tonnes of aluminium a year.
